name: open-subaccount
description: Open a new Savings sub-account for a member and return the new account number.
goal: Set the Account Type dropdown to exactly 'Savings', enter 100 as the Initial Deposit, click Continue to reach the review screen, then click Confirm & Open Account. Finally, extract the value shown next to 'New Account Number' on the success page using the extract tool with outputKey newAccountNumber.
